rate_path.rationale: The Committee held the rate and emphasized a cautious, data-dependent path. No strong push for tightening or easing; views were balanced and forward-looking but not leaning toward action. The minutes show no unambiguous direction or urgency, consistent with a balanced stance.

evidence.quote: After assessing the outlook for economic activity, the labor market, and inflation and weighing the uncertainties associated with the outlook, all but one member agreed to leave the target range for the federal funds rate unchanged at this meeting.

In determining whether it will be appropriate to raise the target range at its next meeting, the Committee will assess progress--both realized and expected--toward its objectives of maximum employment and 2 percent inflation.
